question: Implement the retry engine so the retry decision is a pure function of the typed failure class, not of the raw error text. Exact target: a schema-invalid failure must be retried ZERO times, a provider transient up to its cap, and a second failure on the same fingerprint must trigger the two-strikes pivot rather than a third attempt.

This engine binds to the closed class set named in IMP-0449's catalog question_or_target and refuses raw error text at the API. retry.policy: two strikes then pivot (AGENTS.md 4b): after the SECOND failure on the same fingerprint, PIVOT with required_fix named rather than a third attempt. schema-invalid retries=0.

reviewer.note: Probe 2 does not reuse the per-class table. It holds the fingerprint constant, asserts PIVOT at strike two, AST-scans decide() for message fields, and runs a text-matching mutant.
